_source: T-SQL function signatures and one-line summaries, written for KratosForge from Microsoft's T-SQL reference (learn.microsoft.com/sql/t-sql/functions). Arguments in [ ] are optional.
approx_count_distinct: Approximate number of distinct non-null values.
ascii: ASCII code of the first character.
avg: Average of the values in a group; nulls are ignored.
cast: Converts a value to another data type.
ceiling: Smallest integer greater than or equal to the number.
charindex: Starting position of one string in another, from 1; 0 when not found.
checksum: Hash value computed over a row or a list of expressions.
choose: The item at the given 1-based index from a list of values.
coalesce: The first argument that isn't null.
concat: Joins strings end to end; nulls count as empty strings.
concat_ws: Joins strings with a separator, skipping nulls.
convert: Converts a value to another data type, with an optional style for dates and numbers.
count: Number of items in a group (int).
count_big: Number of items in a group (bigint).
cume_dist: Cumulative distribution of a value in its partition (window function).
current_timestamp: Current date and time of the server, as datetime. Written without parentheses.
datalength: Number of bytes used to store the value.
dateadd: Adds a number of dateparts (year, month, day, ...) to a date.
datediff: Number of datepart boundaries crossed between two dates (int).
datediff_big: Number of datepart boundaries crossed between two dates (bigint).
datefromparts: A date built from year, month and day.
datename: The datepart of a date as text, such as the month name.
datepart: The datepart of a date as an integer.
datetrunc: The date truncated to the start of the datepart.
dense_rank: Rank of each row in its partition, without gaps (window function).
eomonth: Last day of the month of a date, optionally months later.
exp: e raised to the given power.
first_value: First value in an ordered window frame.
floor: Largest integer less than or equal to the number.
format: A value formatted with a .NET format string.
getdate: Current date and time of the server, as datetime.
getutcdate: Current UTC date and time, as datetime.
grouping: 1 when the column is aggregated in a ROLLUP, CUBE or GROUPING SETS row, else 0.
hashbytes: Hash of the input with MD2, MD4, MD5, SHA, SHA1, SHA2_256 or SHA2_512.
iif: One of two values, depending on a condition.
isdate: 1 when the expression is a valid date, time or datetime, else 0.
isjson: 1 when the string is valid JSON, else 0.
isnull: The replacement value when the first argument is null.
isnumeric: 1 when the expression is a valid number, else 0.
json_modify: The JSON text with the value at the path changed.
json_query: An object or array from JSON text.
json_value: A scalar value from JSON text.
lag: Value from a previous row in the window (window function).
last_value: Last value in an ordered window frame.
lead: Value from a following row in the window (window function).
left: The leftmost characters of a string.
len: Number of characters, without trailing spaces.
log: Natural logarithm, or the logarithm in the given base.
ltrim: The string without leading spaces (or the given characters).
ntile: The bucket number of each row when its partition is split into n groups (window function).
nullif: Null when the two values are equal, else the first.
object_id: The object identification number of a schema-scoped object.
parse: A string converted to a date, time or number type, in a culture.
patindex: Starting position of the first match of a LIKE pattern; 0 when none.
percent_rank: Relative rank of a row in its partition, from 0 to 1 (window function).
percentile_cont: Interpolated percentile of a column. Used with WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) OVER (...).
percentile_disc: Percentile of a column, as one of its values. Used with WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) OVER (...).
power: A number raised to a power.
quotename: The string with delimiters added, to make a valid identifier.
rank: Rank of each row in its partition, with gaps after ties (window function).
replace: Every occurrence of a string replaced with another.
replicate: The string repeated a number of times.
right: The rightmost characters of a string.
round: A number rounded (or truncated, when function isn't 0) to a length.
row_number: Sequential number of each row in its partition, from 1 (window function).
rtrim: The string without trailing spaces (or the given characters).
schema_name: The name of a schema, or the caller's default schema.
sign: -1, 0 or 1, for a negative, zero or positive number.
soundex: A four-character code for how a string sounds.
space: A string of that many spaces.
stdev: Sample standard deviation of the values.
stdevp: Population standard deviation of the values.
str: A number as text, right-aligned to a length.
string_agg: The values of a group joined with a separator. WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) sets the order.
string_split: A table of the substrings of a string (table-valued, used in FROM).
stuff: A string with part of it deleted and another string inserted there.
substring: Part of a string, binary, text or image value, from a 1-based start.
sum: Sum of the values in a group.
switchoffset: A datetimeoffset value moved to another time zone offset.
sysdatetime: Current date and time of the server, as datetime2(7).
sysdatetimeoffset: Current date and time with the server's time zone offset, as datetimeoffset(7).
sysutcdatetime: Current UTC date and time, as datetime2(7).
timefromparts: A time built from its parts.
todatetimeoffset: A datetimeoffset value from a datetime2 and an offset.
translate: The string with each character of one list replaced by the matching character of another.
trim: The string without leading and trailing spaces (or the given characters).
try_cast: Converts a value to another type, or null when it can't.
try_convert: Converts a value to another type, or null when it can't.
try_parse: Parses a string to a date, time or number type, or null when it can't.
unicode: The Unicode code point of the first character.
